propositions: When a ticket's acceptance criteria no longer match reality (invalidated by the fix or by subsequent work), the completion verifier blocks close and the documented path forward is missing.
Closing against stale criteria via --force-close or --ref leaves inaccurate state in the ticket system; the correct path is to edit criteria, re-pass plan review, then close.
The --ref escape hatch legitimately solves criteria invalidated by subsequent work, but not criteria invalidated by the fix itself or auto-generated unverifiable criteria.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces re-review of already-executed plans when the criteria registry changes, stranding completed work with no legitimate close path.
Documentation must distinguish between three criterion-invalidation subclasses and prescribe the correct remediation for each.
